segments.text: "The path I walk... is filled with nothing but beauty"
A beautiful man. His fascinating voice attracts the women of the world, be they young or old. "Sugi-sama! Kyakya!"
Battle quote - "Fufu... beauty... is deceiving!"
From Alice Soft wiki
美麗にして華麗なる男。魅惑のボイスは老若
を問わず、世の女性たちを魅了する。
Rouga is a man with a strong sense of justice who enjoys a good fight and fine women. With a strong body and great reflexes, he seeks to dominate the entire nation.

He was trained by his older brother, Zanma Gou. And while Rouga often is annoyed by Gou's antics and tend to punch him into oblivion, he does heed his brother's advice and show a degree of respect for him.
Rouga is betrothed to Tenrou Kunagi, and cares quite a bit for her. Although that does not seem to stop him from loving other women as well.
Edited from Alice Soft wiki

She's the type that's too serious and feels the call of duty strongly, as well as being meddlesome and careful about appearances, but she aims to catch Rouga through battle. She was never any good at battle, but she trains hard every day in order to protect the peace of the school and to remain at Rouga's side.
